title: Constant-factor hardness of uniform sparsest cut
exact_target: For each fixed $C>1$, is approximating uniform sparsest cut within factor C NP-hard on explicitly encoded finite undirected graphs with nonnegative rational capacities and unit demand between each pair of distinct vertices?
